audience: Dutch employers and HR or payroll staff who use Loket.nl with their own API client

useCases.title: Check who is on leave today
useCases.text: List the employees of an employer, then list the absences of one employee, such as sick leave and leave. Open one absence for its expected duration and progress.

useCases.title: Review payroll administrations and their periods
useCases.text: List the payroll administrations of an employer with their period type and start and end dates. Open one to read its address and client number.

useCases.title: Find an employee and read their contact details
useCases.text: List the employees of an employer with their names and employee numbers. Open one record for the personal details and contact information.

useCases.title: Follow open leave requests and other workflows
useCases.text: List the workflows of an employer, such as leave requests and contract changes, with their status and dates. Open one to read its current task and comments.

useCases.title: Map departments and national holidays for planning
useCases.text: List the departments of an employer with their codes and descriptions. List the national holidays that apply to the same employer for planning.
